card.name: Lab monitoring interval wording
card.fires_on: The word "every" or the space right after it, in instructions to monitor blood counts or liver tests at set intervals (e.g. every 2 weeks), just before the number of weeks or months.

modes.label: Monitoring interval
modes.description: The word every, or the space after it, in a schedule for blood counts or liver tests, right before the number.
modes.example: Monitor complete blood counts prior to the start of VERZENIO therapy, every<< >>2 weeks for the first 2 months

modes.label: Other spots before a number
modes.description: A number or short linking word in a similar schedule or instruction.
modes.example: Obtain a complete blood cell count (CBC), including lymphocyte count, <<6>> months after initiation of VUMERITY

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a number or time span, and away from interview or examination words.
card.plain: It fires on "every" in lab-check schedules, just before the interval such as 2 weeks.
